interpretation: Each whole round re-solves preflop against frozen exact continuation values, then re-solves postflop at the changed ranges. A candidate replaces the retained policy only when every selected branch is reached, conditional gaps meet the declared target and full six-seat NashConv improves materially. Stop at the first rejected round. Resume restores an explicit average policy and freshly audits it; it does not restore CFR regret tables. Unselected flops and multiway pots check down. These finite-game checks do not certify safe subgame solving, convergence, full cash poker or trainer admission.
